property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer calls the target contract with the selector for transferFrom(address,address,uint256) and thus the callee's recorded lastSelector equals that selector; the mutant that uses approve(...) will cause a deployed recorder to observe a different selector for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the selector used for the external call to a different function signature, altering which external function is invoked and thus changing observable behavior when the callee returns.
